evidence_recovery_policy: Pinned read-only source retained unchanged, exclusive private destination, before/after source identity and source/destination hashes; no fallback
allocated_cpu_policy: 64 or fresh trusted exclusive-node CPUTot; NumTasks1 and CPUsPerTask64 required

execution_gate.capture_failure_policy: kill process group, bounded 2-second reap, bounded prefix and original error retained; never truncate and admit
execution_gate.single_controller_reservation_through_te: required, not attested by this template

account_policy.basis: Reviewed accounts script converts expanded billing minutes by 1000 and 60; current account GPU-minute counters and allocation billing must agree
account_policy.b5_reserve: Full maximum wall times allocated/requested GPUs for every outstanding B5 job from live Slurm

snapshot_limitation: Read-only observations cannot guarantee future scheduler/account activity. Controller must serialize all diagnostic admissions and retain this single reservation through terminal reconciliation.
